question: Gurdwara Patalpuri Sahib is located on the bank of river ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sutlej.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Gurdwara Patal Puri **is situated at Rupnagar district in Punjab.
 
• It is built on the banks of the **River Sutlej.**
 
• **Guru Hargobind in 1644** as well as **Guru Har Rai in 1661** were cremated in Gurdwara Patal Puri.
 
• **River Sutlej **originates from Rakshastal Lake.
 
 
• Sutlej River is also known as** ****Shatadru **(Ancient name).
 
• River Sutlej is one of the major tributaries of the Indus.
 
• Sutlej River enters India through **Shipki La pass.**
 
• The **Bhakra-Nangal Dam** is constructed across the Sutlej river.
 
• The Indira Gandhi canal is situated on the Sutlej river.
 
 
 
• Major dams built across the Sutlej river are:
 
 
• Bhakra dam
 
• Nathpa Jhakri Dam
 
• Ropar barrage.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Haridwar, Kanpur, Allahabad, Varanasi, Patna are the major cities situated on the banks of river **Ganga.**
 
• Noida, Mathura, Agra, Firozabad are the major cities situated on the banks of the river **Yamuna.**
 
• Mandi district in Himachal Pradesh is located on the banks of the river **Beas.**
